title: Saturday Raku Workshop at The Kiln Studio
bring: bisque-fired pieces (3 small pieces, max 4in high, created at optional pre-workshop on Nov 18)
cost_text: $150 (includes all materials and kiln firings); lunch available at additional price
how_to_join: Register through The Kiln Studio or Eastern Shore Chamber of Commerce
summary: One-day raku workshop with instructor Kevin Russell on November 21, 2026. All experience levels welcome. Participants glaze and fire three small bisque-fired pieces created either ahead of time or at an optional pre-workshop on November 18.
source_quote: Saturday Nov 21, 2026 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM CST Join us for a one day Raku Workshop with local expert Kevin Russell!
evidence_sentence: The Eastern Shore Chamber of Commerce event page details a Saturday Raku Workshop on November 21, 2026 with Kevin Russell, where participants are instructed on proper Raku glazing techniques and firing.
evidence_quote: Join us for a one day Raku Workshop with local expert Kevin Russell! Participants will be instructed on proper Raku glazing techniques and application, and provided with Raku glazes.
